Class CD

java.lang.Object
lms.domain.CD
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoanableItem
public class CD extends Object implements LoanableItem
Represents a CD in the library collection.

Contains metadata including title, artist, and copy availability.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Ahmad Salameh
